headline: AI debt fears hit tech as the 10-year holds near 5.1% after a hot CPI, while Brent tests $110 on Middle East supply risk.
rates: 10-year about 5.08% and up roughly 8% over 60 days; 2-year near 4.71%, so the curve steepened Friday; a hot CPI has a rate hike being debated.
fed: No FOMC meeting or major Fed speaker on next week's calendar; hike talk after CPI is the live theme.
oil: Brent tested $110 and WTI about $101 midday Friday on supply risk; the IEA is speeding up emergency stock releases and the US may ease some tanker sanctions.
geo: Iran tensions remain the oil wildcard (talk of new strikes on nuclear sites).
